class.name: NetwIdToken
class.brief_description: Proves an account with a signed token from an issuer the server trusts, such as a game's own backend.

method.name: fetch_keys
method.description: Downloads the signing keys from [member keys_url] and resolves with [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. Call it before hosting so the first join does not wait for them.

method.name: hold
method.description: Gives the joining peer a [param token] for [param issuer] whose nonce names the private [param key], used before asking the source set with [method provide].

method.name: provide
method.description: Sets where the joining peer gets tokens for [param issuer]. [param fetch] takes the nonce the token must carry and returns a [NetwPromise] of the token. A later call for the same issuer replaces it, and an empty [Callable] removes it.

members.member: The token's [code]aud[/code] must be this, alone or as the only entry of a list.
The public key that checks every token, such as a [code].pub[/code] file shipped with the game. It is used before [member keys_url].
The address of the issuer's JWKS key set. A token checked against it must name its key with [code]kid[/code].
The claim read as the account's display name.
Put before the token's [code]sub[/code] with a colon to make the account, as in [code]"mygame:42"[/code].
